title: Design: the no-match empty state
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Reports — Page Access'.
  • Use a desktop browser window exactly 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so the screen matches the design pictures' size.
custom_steps:
1. Open Reports › Sales by Tier.
  2. Untick both options in the Sales Type filter.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Sales by Tier opens.

Step 2:

  • The table reads "No record matches these filters" and "Try changing filters to widen your results." with a Clear All Filters button.
  • The column headings stay above the message, with no Totals row, as in picture 20.23.
